deals.title: taubenkobel.austria is back in Vienna for its eleventh winter, and this time barbara.eselboeck and alain_weissgerber set the table
deals.description: taubenkobel.austria is back in Vienna for its eleventh winter, and this time barbara.eselboeck and alain_weissgerber set the table inside a garage. Blue overalls on the floor, white toques in the kitchen, a Porsche 935 from fat.international in the middle of the room and light installations by billithanner on the concrete → Taubenkobel (literally a pigeon loft) is Eselböck and Weissgerber’s restaurant in Schützen am Gebirge in Burgenland. Every year before Christmas they move to Vienna for a few weeks, each time to a different address. This year’s pop-up is called TurboTaube, and everything runs on motorsport, down to the campaign shot of whipped cream splattered over a blue car. The Astoria Garage on Trautsongasse in the eighth district is the oldest multistory garage still standing in Vienna. Car pioneer Cesar Karrer founded it in 1918, and from 1935 on it grew into a tower garage with a glass dome. Dinner is served on the first floor, in the former repair shop. What’s on the menu stays a secret until you sit down. You pick a race: Le Mans is the long distance, five courses every night for €220. Monaco is the short, elegant lap, three courses Monday to Wednesday for €120, pre-order only. Vegetarian, pescatarian and vegan versions are also pre-order only, so note them when you book. TurboTaube runs until December 22, Monday to Saturday from 6 p.m., at Trautsongasse 4, 1080 Vienna. Christmas parties in the garage can be booked separately 🏁 Images: © Taubenkobel | © Jung von Matt | Taubenkobel | © Jung von Matt #StyleSolace #TurboTaube #Taubenkobel #AstoriaGarage #ViennaFoo

deals.description: This week at Villa Vida: we remember our trans siblings, celebrate 44 years of the Villa, and dance to Black queer sound. Save this post and bring someone you love. Trans Day of Remembrance on 20.11 honours the trans people taken from us by transphobic violence, especially Black and Brown trans women, and reminds us that remembering means fighting for the living. That same night, the Villa's 44th birthday celebrates a house project built by queer activists who fought for this space. We honour the queer elders whose resistance and joy made it possible for all of us to gather here today. deals.description: As part of Albanian Cuisine Month, NOSH Vienna proudly welcomes a special celebration of Albanian gastronomy, where rich culinary heritage meets modern creativity. On November 22nd, we are delighted to host Chef Silvana Musej, joining us from Italy for an exclusive culinary experience that brings a fresh perspective to the flavors and traditions of Albania. With a unique culinary vision, Chef Silvana will reinterpret the essence of Albanian cuisine through contemporary techniques, refined presentation, and creative expression — honoring its roots while exploring new culinary horizons. More than a dining experience, this evening is a celebration of identity, culture, and the stories that connect us through food. November 22, 2026 | 16:30 NOSH Restaurant | Vienna, Austria Proudly hosted in collaboration with Albchef, as part of Albanian Cuisine Month.
